summary.text: Gary Josephson is an independent write-in candidate for Ohio's 15th Congressional District. He was the Democratic nominee for the seat in 2022, losing to Mike Carey, and describes a long background as a union representative and community organizer.

paragraphs.text: Josephson earned a bachelor's degree from Ohio State University in 1980. In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an activist for more than 50 years, with experience as a union representative, community activist and youth worker, and as president of CWA Local 4501.
He said he studied elections, legislation, environment, constitution, banking, arbitration and international human rights at the Ohio State University law school.

Josephson finished fifth with 6.6% in the April 28, 2020 Democratic primary for Ohio House District 25. In 2022 he won the May 3 Democratic primary for Ohio's 15th District unopposed, then lost the November 8 general election to Mike Carey, 43.0% to 57.0%.
